narration.text: Why the first lab burger cost $325,000.
It took 20,000 thin strands of muscle tissue.
From 2021 to 2023, companies raised over $2.5 billion.
Scaling up means growing cells cheaply in giant tanks.
Price, not taste, decides whether it reaches your plate.
So the hardest part of lab meat is the factory.
